entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I... I think I need to return something. I'm a bit confused about the process.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. I can definitely help you with that. To get started, could I please have your name and order number?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller, order number VF789012. It's about the helmet I bought.

Thank you, Sarah. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Urban Commuter Helmet, delivered nine days ago. To make sure I get you to the right place, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, um, a preference, I think? The color just wasn't what I expected from the website picture. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it. I was looking online and got so overwhelmed. I just don't know what to do. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can absolutely help you with this. It's no problem at all. We want to make sure you love your gear, especially when it comes to safety equipment. Since it's only been nine days, you're well within our 90-day return policy for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. So it's okay that I just changed my mind about the color?

Yes, completely fine. That's exactly what the policy is for. I'm emailing you a prepaid return shipping label right now. You just need to print it, attach it to the original box with the helmet inside, and you can drop it off at any designated shipping location.
Wow, okay. That sounds much easier than I thought. Thank you so much, Alex.

You are very welcome, Sarah. Once our warehouse receives the return, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was everything. You've been a great help.
I'm happy to hear that. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
